title: Scam Sentinel training corpus
description: A set of labelled DuitNow account timelines. Each timeline holds up to 14 transfers, oldest first; the newest transfer is the one the label refers to.

id.description: Pseudonymised account id. Never a real account number.

label.description: 1 = newest transfer is a confirmed APP scam payment, 0 = confirmed legitimate.

scenario.description: Category word only, e.g. routine, big new payee, investment, impersonation, job, purchase.

ownerTypicalAmount.description: Owner's usual outbound transfer size in RM (e.g. 90-day median).

transfers.description: Oldest first. Fewer than 14 is allowed; the importer left-pads.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 with offset. If present, hourOfDay and secondsSincePrevious may be omitted.

receiverAccountAgeDays.description: Omit if unknown; importer substitutes 365 and flags the row.

receiverFanOut1h.description: Distinct first-time receivers the receiver paid in the 60 min ending at this timestamp (burst dispersal).

onwardNonBankExitShare.description: Optional, default 0. Share of the receiver's onward outflow (24 h) that left via e-wallet top-up, crypto OTC trader, or cardless ATM withdrawal.

onwardStructuredShare.description: Optional, default 0. Share of the receiver's onward transfers (24 h) that are equal-sized slices or sit just under a transfer/reporting limit.

onwardYoungReceiverShare.description: Optional, default 0. Share of the receiver's onward receivers (24 h) whose accounts are under 90 days old.

amountVsTypical.description: Derived when omitted: amount / ownerTypicalAmount (1 for inbound).

isRoundAmount.description: Derived when omitted: amount >= 1000 and divisible by 500.
